method: Read-only review of the current diff, complete ownership/copy/graph paths and relevant tests. No native campaign, profile, test suite or build executed by this review. A tiny language-only Node probe confirmed Object.getOwnPropertyNames versus descriptor-record integer-key ordering.

resolvedFindings.issue: New hydration provenance could certify a foreign container returned by an own array map method or custom Symbol.species.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Hydration allocates its own plain arrays and groups with indexed loops. Only private decoder construction calls freezeHydrated; exported isHydratedNativeJson is read-only. Adversarial own-map, species and parts-map tests prevent externally supplied output containers from receiving provenance.

resolvedFindings.issue: Direct descriptor collection initially skipped the array length descriptor and preserved reordered Proxy integer keys, changing accepted-input snapshot semantics.
resolvedFindings.resolution: All parent descriptors, including array length, are acquired before child traversal. Arrays regain contiguous numeric order; retainNativeJson also restores ordinary integer-key ordering for object Proxies while preserving nonindex order. Tests cover length-descriptor side effects, reordered valid array Proxies, mutated parent siblings and numeric object child traversal.

resolvedFindings.issue: New hydration loops initially reread input collection identity and length during child decoding instead of preserving the previous Array.map length snapshot.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Each source array/parts identity and length is captured before traversal. Tests mutate source length during first-child decoding and verify that the original bounded extent determines output.

acceptedDesign: copyNativeValue fast copies only private canonical ingress or decoder-owned immutable containers. Object.freeze and retainNativeJson alone do not grant this certificate to foreign objects.

Each copy uses its own identity map, preserving aliases within the detached copy while separating the source and successive copies. Foreign accessors, collections, cycles and Proxies retain structuredClone behavior; functions and symbols retain rejection.

Raw scalar values, finite Float64 values, negative zero, Unicode keys, literal __proto__ keys and object member order remain covered. Existing scalar, depth, cycle and structural limits remain in their validating paths.

Cross-root leaf reuse still performs the authoritative fragment lookup. Content-address validation, replaced/missing dependencies, composite dependency traversal and repeated-reference depth checking are unchanged.

Inventory source publication remains after preparation; the customized-restorer fallback is unchanged. The helper is also used at CellProjection.restore without changing its source method identity checks.
explicitBehaviorChanges: Malformed raw encoded arrays containing holes now fail decoding instead of returning sparse output. Graphs produced by splitNativeState are dense and unaffected.
Own map methods and custom array species on raw encoded collections no longer choose decoded output containers. Outputs are plain locally constructed immutable trees.
remainingLimits: This review does not establish full V5/V6 caller parity, whole-graph equality, all-game regression coverage or any performance gain.
Formal frozen-source test/build/replay receipts and the separately predeclared cost window remain required; agent-reported targeted tests are not counted as reviewer executions.
The diagnostic baseline isolation qualification remains separate. This code review makes no timing or overlap assertion.
